evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Agent evaluations often use one benchmark to choose a workflow and then search for task types where its advantage weakens, so both conclusions are selected from the same data.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Selection-Aware Semantic Stress Testing (\SASST{}), which learns a task reweighting from pre-execution features on discovery tasks and evaluates the same paired comparison on separate confirmation tasks.
